en.headline: Coffee fair at The Mills runs through Sunday
en.dek: The Urban Brew Summit's second weekend brings Japanese and local roasters to Tsuen Wan until Sunday evening.
body: The Urban Brew Summit at The Mills in Tsuen Wan is in its final weekend. The Mills said the fair, held with BGBMHK, runs from noon to 8:30 p.m. on Saturday and Sunday, after an earlier weekend from 24 to 27 September.

The organisers said the event brings together about 50 selected brands. An overseas tasting area features independent Japanese roasters from cities including Tokyo, Kyoto, Kanazawa and Yokohama, some appearing in Hong Kong for the first time. A separate market on the first floor of Mill 6 is open without a ticket and includes local coffee, tea and bakery stalls.

The overseas tasting session is ticketed at HK$220, which the organisers said covers three 80-millilitre pours and a tasting cup. The Mills is at 45 Pak Tin Par Street, Tsuen Wan. The fair ends on Sunday.

zh.headline: 南豐紗廠咖啡節展至周日
zh.dek: Urban Brew Summit 第二個周末在荃灣舉行，周日晚上8時半結束。
body: 荃灣南豐紗廠的 Urban Brew Summit 咖啡節進入最後一個周末。紗廠表示，活動與「表哥表妹」合辦，周六及周日中午12時至晚上8時半舉行；較早一個周末為9月24日至27日。
主辦方稱，場內約有50個精選品牌。海外咖啡體驗區有來自東京、京都、金澤及橫濱等地的日本獨立烘焙品牌，部分首次來港。六廠一樓市集免費入場，有本地咖啡、茶飲及烘焙攤檔。
海外體驗時段門票220元，主辦方表示包括三杯各80毫升的手沖咖啡及一個品嚐杯。紗廠地址是荃灣白田壩街45號。活動周日結束。
